'''Alexander Pavlovich Voitovich''' (also transliterated as '''Aleksandr Voitovich'''; born 5 January 1938) is a Belarusian politician, physicist, and activist. He served as Speaker of the [[Council of the Republic (Belarus)|Council of the Republic]] from 2000 to 2003 and  President of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Belarus]] from 1997 to 2001.

Voitovich was born in Rachkevichi, which is part of the [[Kapyl district]], in the [[Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic|Byelorussian SSR]]. He attended the Institute of Physics at the Belarusian State University, graduating in 1978 with a [[Doctor of Sciences]]. Afterwards, he continued in the physics field,  primarily covering [[gas lasers]] and [[spectroscopy]]. In May 1997 he was elected President of the [[Belarusian Academy of Sciences]], a position he stayed at until 2001. During his time as president, he helped expand scientific cooperation with state administration and NAS, helped strengthen the international position of NAS, and helped with better organization during a difficult time for the academy because of economic circumstances. In December 2000, upon President [[Alexander Lukashenko]]'s suggestion Voitovich was appointed Speaker of the [[Council of the Republic (Belarus)|Council of the Republic]] of the second convocation. In this role he met with numerous foreign allies and international organizations, including the [[IMF]] and [[China]]. However, in 2003, he was suddenly terminated by presidential decree from Lukashenko for declaring a [[minute of silence]] in memory of dissident [[Vasil Bykov]]. This led him to immediately become part of the [[Belarusian opposition]] and an activist.

As part of the opposition, he notably ran as a candidate for the [[2006 Belarusian presidential election]]. Declaring that there was not equal access in the elections and [[Electoral fraud|rigged]], he also attacked Lukashenko numerous times for running for a third term when the limit was two. Eventually, he withdrew from the elections, and wrote a letter to Prime Minister [[Sergei Sidorsky]] asking him to step up, which he did not do. Since the elections, he has led a small laboratory for laser spectroscopy and has been a continuous voice of opposition, comparing the current regime to [[Nazi]]s and having policies similar to that of [[Joseph Stalin]].
== Early life ==
Alexander Pavlovich Voitovich was born on 5 January 1938 in the village of Rachkevichi, which is part of the [[Kapyl district]], in the [[Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic|Byelorussian SSR]].<ref>{{cite book |title=Posev |date=2004 |publisher=Izd-vo Posev |page=9 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=D6sTAQAAMAAJ&q=%D0%90%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D1%80+%D0%9F%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87+%D0%92%D0%BE%D0%B9%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87+%C2%AB5+%D1%8F%D0%BD%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%8F+1938+%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%B0%C2%BB |access-date=23 February 2025 |language=ru}}</ref> He was born into a peasant family.<ref name="early">{{cite web |title=Вайтовіч Аляксандр Паўлавіч - Беларусь у асобах i падзеях |url=https://bis.nlb.by/en/documents/130186 |website=bis.nlb.by |access-date=23 February 2025}}</ref> After graduating with honors from high school, he went to the Faculty of Physics at the [[Belarusian State University]], where he also graduated with honors in 1960.<ref>{{cite web |title=Национальная академия наук Беларуси :: Официальный веб-сайт |url=http://nasb.gov.by/rus/publications/vestifm/vfm08_1b.php |access-date=22 February 2025 |date=29 July 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090729095829/http://nasb.gov.by/rus/publications/vestifm/vfm08_1b.php |archive-date=29 July 2009 }}</ref> In 1968 he defended his candidate's thesis, and in 1978 he was created a [[Doctor of Sciences]] with his doctoral thesis entitled "Magneto-optical Effects in Gas Lasers".<ref>{{cite book |last1=Pribylovskiĭ |first1=Vladimir |title=Rukovoditeli gosudarstv na territorii byvshego SSSR: biograficheskiĭ spravochnik : versii͡a 3-i͡a, peresmotrennai͡a i dopolnennai͡a po sostoi͡anii͡u na 1 fevrali͡a 2002 |date=2002 |publisher=IIT͡S "Panorama" |page=36 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=bLcjAQAAIAAJ&q=%D0%90%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D1%80+%D0%9F%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87+%D0%92%D0%BE%D0%B9%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87+%221978%22+%D0%9C%D0%B0%D0%B3%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BE%D0%BF%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B5+%D1%8D%D1%84%D1%84%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%82%D1%8B+%D0%B2+%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%8B%D1%85+%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%85 |access-date=23 February 2025 |language=ru}}</ref>

Since 1960 he has worked at the Institute of Physics of the [[Belarusian Academy of Sciences]], where he rose from being a junior researcher to deputy director, actively working the field of [[laser physics]] and creating a laser [[spectroscopy]] laboratory.<ref name="early" /> In 1980 he became head of the laboratory at the Institute of Physics and from 1948 to 1988 he was the Deputy Director for Scientific Work of the institute.<ref name="nasb" /> From 1992 to 1933 he was Deputy Director for Research at the Institute of Molecular and Atomic Physics of the [[Belarusian Academy of Sciences]], then director from 1993 to 1997.<ref>{{cite web |title=Войтович Александр · Slounik.org |url=https://slounik.org/80038.html |website=slounik.org |access-date=23 February 2025 |language=be}}</ref>

=== Scientific work ===
In his work in laser physics, he developed a method for selecting laser frequencies based on saturation parameters, discovered qualitatively new [[polarization (waves)|polarization]] phenomena in [[gas lasers]] in a [[magnetic field]], established the role of the processes of forced [[Resonance Raman spectroscopy]] in the active medium in the formation of laser characteristics, and identified and studied the phenomena of [[Spontaneous symmetry breaking|spontaneous violations]] of polarization in [[Mirror symmetry (string theory)|mirror symmetry]] in lasers up to obtaining completed [[chirality|chiral]] purity.<ref name="nasb">{{cite web |title=Акадэмікі :: ВАЙТОВІЧ Аляксандр Паўлавіч |url=https://nasb.gov.by/bel/members/akademiki/voitovich.php |website=nasb.gov.by |access-date=23 February 2025}}</ref>
== Political career ==

=== President of the National Academy of Sciences ===
On 16 May 1997, he was elected President of the [[Belarusian Academy of Sciences]] by a secret ballot, and was chosen out of 4 candidates.<ref name="president">{{cite web |title=Краткий очерк о деятельности |url=http://library.basnet.by/html/csl/338/2.htm |website=library.basnet.by |access-date=23 February 2025}}</ref> He had previously been elected a corresponding member of the academy in 1986 and a full member in 1996.<ref>{{cite book |title=Кто есть кто в Беларуси |date=2001 |publisher=Мэджик Бук |isbn=978-985-6544-16-6 |page=56 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=VR8hAQAAMAAJ&q=%D0%90%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D1%80+%D0%9F%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87+%D0%92%D0%BE%D0%B9%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87+%221986%22+1996 |access-date=23 February 2025 |language=ru}}</ref>

He was elected during a difficult time for the academy because of economic circumstances, and soon after [[Alexander Lukashenko]] set the task to the task of better organization and increasing its efficiency.<ref name="president" /> In response, Voitovich created a "mini-program" of actions that were approved and then a "maximum program" to set out specific measures for the next 5 years which was approved in April 1998.<ref name="president" /> He also set out to expand interaction with state administration and NAS, which he did through his role as a member of the [[Government of Belarus#Council of Ministers|Council of Ministers]].<ref name="president" /> In May 1998 a law was signed that defined the basic principles of interactions between state authorities and NAS, and the salaries of scientific workers were increased by 1.7 times.<ref name="president" /> He also tried to reach out to international authorities to strengthen the position of NAS, visiting [[UNESCO]] multiple times.<ref name="president" />

In December 2000, Voitovich was appointed senator, which meant he had to leave as president of the academy.<ref name="president" />

=== Speaker of the Council of the Republic ===
On 19 December 2000, at the suggestion of [[Alexander Lukashenko]], he was appointed Speaker of the [[Council of the Republic (Belarus)|Council of the Republic]] of the second convocation.<ref>{{cite news |title=Аляксандр Вайтовіч на сваё 75-годдзе: «Палітыкі няма, ёсць самаўладдзе» |url=https://nashaniva.com/102808 |access-date=23 February 2025 |work=Наша Ніва |date=5 January 2013 |language=be}}</ref>

He worked with the [[IMF]] in order to provide an assessment of the transparency of the budget in 2002, after loans were halted by the IMF because of discrepancies.<ref>{{cite web |title=Alexander Voitovich Meets with IMF Mission - Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Belarus |url=https://mfa.gov.by/en/press/news_mfa/abd10683288e7de5.html |website=mfa.gov.by |access-date=25 February 2025}}</ref> He also visited [[China]], specifically [[Hubei]], from 17-24 January 2002 as part of a delegation in order to celebrate the anniversary of diplomatic relations between the two countries. He met with [[Li Peng]], [[Hu Jintao]], and [[Qian Qichen]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Belarus parliamentary delegation will visit China - Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Belarus |url=https://mfa.gov.by/en/press/news_mfa/f8e57ac678d739a4.html |website=mfa.gov.by |access-date=25 February 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=H.E. Mr. Aleksandr VOYTOVICH |url=https://pg.china-embassy.gov.cn/eng/xwdt/200201/t20020110_888227.htm |website=pg.china-embassy.gov.cn |access-date=25 February 2025}}</ref> He also called 2001 a landmark year for the Eurasian economic community, helping set up the [[Eurasian Economic Community]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Chairman of the Council of Republic considers year 2001 an important landmark for Eurasian economic community - Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Belarus |url=https://mfa.gov.by/print/en/press/news_mfa/a2d881b922a54368.html |website=mfa.gov.by |access-date=25 February 2025}}</ref>

On 28 July 2003, Lukashenko recalled Voitovich by presidential decree from the post of speaker after Voitovich, on his own, declared a [[minute of silence]] in memory of [[Vasil Bykov]].<ref name="voit">{{cite news |title=Аляксандар Вайтовіч |url=https://www.svaboda.org/a/2303566.html |access-date=23 February 2025 |work=Радыё Свабода |date=4 January 2006 |language=be}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |title=Национальный реестр правовых актов Республики Беларусь |date=2003 |publisher=Nat͡sionalʹnyĭ t͡sentr pravovoĭ informat͡sii Respubliki Belarusʹ |page=61 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Vt8lAQAAIAAJ&q=%D0%90%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%81%D0%B0%CC%81%D0%BD%D0%B4%D1%80+%D0%9F%D0%B0%CC%81%D0%B2%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87+%D0%92%D0%BE%D0%B9%D1%82%D0%BE%CC%81%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87+%C2%AB28+%D0%B8%D1%8E%D0%BB%D1%8F+2003+%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%B0%C2%BB |access-date=23 February 2025 |language=ru}}</ref> Bykov had been a dissident of Lukashenko and a supporter of the opposition party [[Belarusian Popular Front]], and had died a month before on 22 June. This led him to go to the opposition of the government.<ref name="voit" />

=== Opposition to Lukashenko ===
In 2004, Voitovich said that Lukashenko was running a [[dictatorship]], and that his plan to scrap a [[term limit]] of two terms for a president was "totally illegitimate" and was an "egregious violation" in every step of an election.<ref>{{cite news |title='Illegitimate' poll brings dictatorship to Belarus |url=https://mg.co.za/article/2004-10-19-illegitimate-poll-brings-dictatorship-to-belarus/ |access-date=23 February 2025 |work=The Mail & Guardian |date=19 October 2004 |language=en-ZA}}</ref> He was also appointed head of the initiative "For Fair Elections" that year.

==== 2006 elections ====
In IISEPS polling, a research center in Belarus, that occurred in December 2005 stated that 7.1% of Belarusians would vote for Voitovich in the next elections.<ref>{{cite web |title=Presidential Support Is High, Opposition Low |url=https://ia601307.us.archive.org/27/items/06MINSK25/06MINSK25_djvu.txt |website=ia601307.us.archive.org |access-date=23 February 2025}}</ref>

An initiative group was registered to collect signatures for the nomination of Voitovich as a candidate for the [[2006 Belarusian presidential election]] on 27 December 2005 by Valery Dunaev, which collected 1,304 people, 314 of those signatures were sent to the [[Central Election Commission of Belarus]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Инициативная группа Александра Войтовича зарегистрирована |url=http://news.tut.by/elections/62041.html |access-date=23 February 2025 |work=Tut |date=27 December 2005|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150725174931/http://news.tut.by/elections/62041.html |archive-date=25 July 2015 }}</ref> On 29 December he released a statement alongside another candidate, Valery Frolov who was a deputy and general, that for the elections to be "constitutional and legal" there must be, among other things, the barring of Lukashenko having a third term, equal access be provided to state media, sealing of early voting ballot boxes be carried out, and have representatives in the election commissions.<ref name="statement">{{cite news |title=Александр Войтович и Валерий Фролов перечислили условия, при которых президентские выборы могут считаться "конституционными и законными" |url=http://news.tut.by/elections/62125.html |access-date=23 February 2025 |work=Tut |date=29 December 2005 |archive-date=5 May 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150505101823/http://news.tut.by/elections/62125.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> Otherwise, both threatened to withdraw from the campaign.<ref name="statement" /> 

On 9 February 2006, he announced that he would not participate in the elections and withdrew, saying that the points in his statement had not been met and that the signatures stated by the election commission were not true and that he had at least 20 - 30 thousand.<ref name="response">{{cite news |title=У Лукашенко стало на одного соперника меньше |url=http://news.tut.by/elections/62516.html |access-date=23 February 2025 |work=Tut |date=9 January 2006 |archive-date=4 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304202945/http://news.tut.by/elections/62516.html |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Presidential contender steps down in Belarus |url=https://data.minsk.by/belarusnews/012006/34.html |access-date=23 February 2025 |work=Belarus News and Analysis |date=9 January 2006}}</ref> He further stated that there was already a large-scale campaign for the election of Lukashenko for a new term, which was in violation to the constitution, and said that it was already [[Electoral fraud|rigged]] because Lukashenko repeated statements of an "elegant victory" and "vote for me, where will you go" while authorities complied.<ref name="response" />

He afterward refused to join the coalition team of [[Alyaksandr Kazulin]], stating that other candidates should not participate because there was no true election.<ref>{{cite news |title=Войтович отказался войти в команду Козулина |url=http://news.tut.by/elections/63828.html |access-date=23 February 2025 |work=Tut |date=6 February 2006 |archive-date=26 July 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150726075154/http://news.tut.by/elections/63828.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> He then wrote a letter to Prime Minister [[Sergei Sidorsky]] asking him to make sure the country remains sovereign away from Lukashenko and for him to be head of state.<ref>{{cite news |title="Даже председатель КНР избирается только на два срока" |url=https://gazetaby.com/post/dazhe-predsedatel-knr-izbiraetsya-tolko-na-dva-sroka/2629/ |access-date=25 February 2025 |work=Gazetaby |date=14 September 2006}}</ref> However, Sidorsky never responded and Voitovich said it was a pity that even the opposition let this go.<ref>{{cite news |title=Саше не пишет Сережа |url=https://gazetaby.com/post/sashe-ne-pishet-serezha/3133/ |access-date=25 February 2025 |work=Gazetaby |date=19 October 2006}}</ref>

==== Later career ====
He has worked as the head of a small laboratory for laser spectroscopy at the Institute of Molecular and Atomic Physics at the Academy of Sciences since 2006 alongside four other people.<ref>{{cite web |title=Александру Войтовичу — 75 |url=https://charter97.org/ru/news/2013/1/5/63605/ |website=[[Charter 97|charter97.org]] |access-date=25 February 2025 |language=ru}}</ref> Voitovich has still been an active voice as part of the opposition, talking about the case of Stepan Latypov and comparing the regime to [[Nazi]]s<ref>{{cite web |title=Экс-президент Академии наук Беларуси: Режим совершил преступление против человечества |url=https://charter97.org/ru/news/2021/6/3/424626/ |website=charter97.org |access-date=25 February 2025 |language=ru}}</ref> and [[Joseph Stalin|Stalin]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Александр Войтович: «У нас больная система, похожая на сталинскую» |url=https://charter97.org/ru/news/2010/12/3/34354/ |website=charter97.org |access-date=25 February 2025 |language=ru}}</ref>

In 2010, he was part of the team for [[Andrei Sannikov]], an opposition candidate to Lukashenko.<ref>{{cite web |title=Александру Войтовичу — 75 |url=https://charter97.org/ru/news/2013/1/5/63605/ |website=charter97.org |access-date=25 February 2025 |language=ru}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
He is married and has a son. He also has three grandchildren, and four great-grandchildren.<ref name="hm">{{cite news |title=Академик с расчетным листком опроверг главу НАН: «За октябрь я получил 496 рублей» |url=https://gazetaby.com/post/akademik-s-raschetnym-listkom-oproverg-glavu-nan-za-oktyabr-ya-poluchil-496-rublej/143641/ |access-date=25 February 2025 |work=Gazetaby |date=7 November 2018}}</ref> He said he receives around $500 in rubles each month as his salary, which he considers low for the work in science and stated this is why more young people are not persuaded to go to scientific fields.<ref name="hm" />

* State Prize of Belarus (1996)<ref name="med" />
* [[Order of Francysk Skaryna]] (1998)<ref name="med" />
* [[:ru:Орден «Содружество» (СНГ)|Order of the Commonwealth]] ([[Commonwealth of Independent States|CIS]]; 2002)<ref>{{cite web |title=О награждении орденом "Содружество |url=http://pravo.kulichki.net/megd2007/bz01/dcm01652.htm |access-date=25 February 2025 |date=30 July 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190730155825/http://pravo.kulichki.net/megd2007/bz01/dcm01652.htm |archive-date=30 July 2019 }}</ref>
